messages:
Avery (CSM): Quick sync — Emberlane EBR is Fri 2pm PT. We need a tight 10-slide deck, a 1-page runbook for post-EBR follow-ups, and explicit owners for every open ask. Upload deadline: Thu 9am PT.

Avery (CSM): Key outcomes we want to drive:
- Re-establish exec sponsor engagement
- Show onboarding momentum (not just installs)
- Surface concrete fixes for billing visibility complaints
- Agree on a 60-day success plan to reduce renewal friction

Nina (CS Ops): I'll assemble the health slide: active pipelines, integration latency, and a short incident timeline. Which billing metric should I surface? invoices_paid_on_time or billing_support_tickets?

Tariq (AE): Surface billing_support_tickets (that ties to risk). I'll draft the renewal slide — current sentiment: "neutral", risk flags: low usage in two product modules + delayed legal review. Proposed mitigations: 1) executive touchpoint, 2) tailored integration bootcamp, 3) 10% promo on first paid month.

Ellen (Enablement): I'll run a 45min workshop Wed 11am PT focused on admin flows and billing reconciliation. Recording + short checklist by Wed EOD. Will include a short checklist: "How to validate invoices" and "Where to escalate pricing issues".

Riya (SE): For onboarding status, I'll paste the latest adoption query and a short table of remaining milestones. Quick prod query I'm running:
```sql
SELECT milestone, status, owner, eta
FROM onboarding_tasks
WHERE account = 'emberlane'
ORDER BY eta ASC;
```
I'll drop the CSV and a 1-slide screenshot to the deck drive.

Avery (CSM): Deck-bot created a draft deck in /drive/emberlane/ebr/draft.pptx — please upload slide pngs there. Also tagging: deck-bot will snapshot the final deck at Thu 9am and post to the invite.

Nina (CS Ops): Capturing feedback owners now: billing visibility -> Tariq, docs/API clarity -> Riya, admin UX -> Ellen. Will add these to the "Open Asks" slide with owners and timelines.

Tariq (AE): Quick ask: can SEs export a short before/after metric for the pilot module (search-relevance)? a 2-line stat (e.g., CTR +19%, avg_query_time -34ms) would be ideal.

Riya (SE): I can export those. Will anonymize customer quote and add a one-line pull quote for the "pilot win" slide.

Ellen (Enablement): Office hours Wed 11am PT — invite sent. Recording link: https://drive.example/emberlane/enablement/rec.mp4 (draft).

Avery (CSM): Action items (reply with DONE when finished):
```
- Nina: Health slide + incident timeline + billing tickets metric (due Thu 9am)
- Riya: Adoption query results CSV + pilot metrics + screenshot (due Wed EOD)
- Ellen: Workshop recording + admin checklist slide (due Wed EOD)
- Tariq: Renewal mitigation slide + sponsor touch plan (due Thu 9am)
- Avery: Exec speaking notes + 60-day success plan one-pager (due Thu 9am)
```

Tariq (AE): I'll draft the sponsor cadence: 15-min exec re-intro, 30-min demo for product leaders, weekly ops sync x4. Will tag legal contact Marco for contract timing notes.

Nina (CS Ops): Noted. I'll also add a small risk meter (green/amber/red) and current score.

deck-bot: Reminder set: final deck snapshot at Thu 09:00 PT. Upload required or invite marked as "deck missing".

Avery (CSM): Thanks all — if we get the pilot metrics + the billing checklist in, we should reduce the perceived risk before the EBR. Ping me for any blocker. :muscle:
